breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: Dirichlet and Periodic. The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The agent correctly identified this conflict and generated a specification that explicitly uses only the Dirichlet condition ('Impose Dirichlet boundary conditions u=0 on all four edges for all times.') and explicitly rejects the periodic one ('Do not apply periodic boundary conditions and do not identify endpoints.'), which aligns perfectly with the ground truth.
